items.title: DangoMatcha x Little V's Cafe journaling night
menu: exclusive Little V's matcha (one day only)
items.description: A junk-journaling night at a Hialeah cafe with matcha and coffee on hand and DangoMatcha sticker packs to journal with. The cafe is serving an exclusive matcha for this one day only.
items.notes: Date, time and street address are on the Eventbrite page. Matcha is a feature, not the whole point: a journaling social at a cafe. Hialeah is Miami metro. Price and ticketing not shown on the page.

items.title: Oohmami Matcha at Grant Park Farmers Market
items.description: Oohmami sells matcha drinks and powder at the Sunday Grant Park market. Market hours are 9am to 1pm, year-round.
items.notes: Market date and hours are on the cfmatl page (Sundays year-round, it lists a Dec 28 2026 closure). Oohmami is not named on that page; Sunday attendance comes from April and June 2026 press, so each date assumes the stall shows up. Dec 27 skipped because of the listed closure wording. Confirm on @oohmamimatcha.

items.brand: Blind Tiger Coffee Roasters (Matcha & Mimosa Sundays)
items.title: Ybor City Matcha & Mimosa Sundays
items.venue: Blind Tiger Coffee Roasters - Ybor City Cafe
menu: pancakes, breakfast tacos, avocado toast, acai bowls, pastries
items.description: A recurring Sunday brunch at the Ybor City cafe with matcha next to coffee, mimosas and a full brunch menu.
items.notes: Eventbrite page says Every Sunday and Multiple dates but shows no individual dates or times in the text I could read. Matcha is one of several drinks, so it is weak as a matcha pop-up. Nov 29 is already on the map.
